brightness.description: The brightness level (0-100%). Only applicable if 'on' is true.

color_hex.description: The desired color in hexadecimal format (e.g., 'FF0000' for red). Mutually exclusive with color_temperature_kelvin.

color_temperature_kelvin.description: The desired color temperature in Kelvin (e.g., 2700 for warm white, 6500 for cool white). Mutually exclusive with color_hex.

transition_time_ms.description: The time in milliseconds for the light to transition to the new state.
